promotion_rule: Add only verified reusable lessons with Issue/PR/SHA/test evidence. Promote repeated execution lessons into the relevant skill or automated rule.

lessons.rule: Business UI must not expose visible raw internal IDs/JSON when an authoritative lookup/enum/builder exists.
Multiple row actions collapse into the canonical ellipsis/overflow pattern.
Retained dynamic data must be visibly stale/offline instead of appearing live.
Short owner prompts such as 'اعمل صفحة' inherit the full FOODEX UI/UX contract and do not authorize a new design language.
